description: DotTTS is a multilingual zero-shot TTS, voice-cloning, and speech-editing model family packaged for audio.cpp with SOAR and MeanFlow generation, prompt-audio plus prompt-text prefill, speaker-reference conditioning, language tags, multiple synthesis templates, long-form text chunking, and true streaming audio output.

request.name: reference_text
request.description: Transcript for the prompt audio. When set with reference audio, DotTTS uses prompt prefill for higher quality voice cloning.

request.name: reference_duration_sec
request.description: Optional prompt-audio trim duration before reference conditioning and prompt prefill.

request.name: template_name
request.description: DotTTS synthesis template. tts is normal text-to-speech; instruction_tts adds instruction conditioning; text_to_audio uses a sound-description template; tts_interleave uses the streaming interleave schedule; edit uses the DotTTS Edit source-audio editing schedule.

request.name: source_audio
request.description: Source WAV path for DotTTS Edit. Required when template_name=edit unless audio_input is supplied by the caller.

request.name: instruction
request.description: Structured DotTTS Edit instruction. If omitted with template_name=edit, the request text is used as the instruction.

request.name: instruct
request.description: Alias for instruction for CLI compatibility.

request.name: source_text
request.description: Optional source transcript override for DotTTS Edit. If omitted, it is rendered from instruction tags.

request.name: target_text
request.description: Optional target transcript override for DotTTS Edit. If omitted, it is rendered from instruction tags.

request.name: use_xvector
request.description: DotTTS Edit speaker conditioning mode. auto follows the upstream tag-based behavior; on/off force or disable source-audio speaker conditioning.

request.name: language
request.description: Optional target language tag. none disables language tagging; otherwise pass a language code such as en or zh.

request.name: num_inference_steps
request.description: SOAR flow-matching inference step count; default 10.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: Classifier-free guidance scale used by SOAR flow matching. Default 1.2.

request.name: speaker_scale
request.description: Multiplier applied to the prompt speaker embedding; default 1.5.

request.name: sampler_mode
request.description: SOAR ODE solver method for flow matching. Fixed-step euler is the default and parity baseline.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated audio patch count per generated segment; default 500.

request.name: seed
request.description: Seed for prompt latent sampling and flow noise initialization; default 42.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Shared matmul weight storage type for DotTTS components; default native. Component-specific weight options override this value.

session.name: speaker_encoder_weight_type
session.description: Speaker encoder matmul weight storage type; defaults to weight_type.

session.name: codec_weight_type
session.description: AudioVAE vocoder matmul and recurrent weight storage type; defaults to weight_type.

session.name: patch_encoder_weight_type
session.description: Patch encoder transformer matmul weight storage type; defaults to weight_type.

session.name: llm_weight_type
session.description: Autoregressive language model matmul weight storage type; defaults to weight_type.

session.name: flow_weight_type
session.description: SOAR or MeanFlow DiT flow-matching matmul weight storage type; defaults to weight_type.

session.name: codec_conv_weight_type
session.description: Convolution weight storage type; default native.

session.name: reference_cache_slots
session.description: Prepared reference-audio cache slots; set 0 to disable reuse.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Load DotTTS components by request phase and release their weights/graphs after last use while keeping reference cache slots alive.

description.en: DotTTS is a multilingual zero-shot TTS, voice-cloning, and speech-editing model family packaged for audio.cpp with SOAR and MeanFlow generation, prompt-audio plus prompt-text prefill, speaker-reference conditioning, language tags, multiple synthesis templates, long-form text chunking, and true streaming audio output.
description.zh: DotTTS 是面向 audio.cpp 打包的多语言零样本 TTS、音色克隆与语音编辑模型家族，具备 SOAR 与 MeanFlow 生成、提示音频+提示文本预填充、说话人参考条件、语言标签、多合成模板、长文本分块与真流式音频输出。

reference_text.en: Transcript for the prompt audio. When set with reference audio, DotTTS uses prompt prefill for higher quality voice cloning.
reference_text.zh: 提示音频对应的文本。与参考音频一起提供时，DotTTS 会用提示预填充，音色克隆质量更好。

reference_duration_sec.en: Optional prompt-audio trim duration before reference conditioning and prompt prefill.
reference_duration_sec.zh: 可选的提示音频截取时长，作用在参考条件与提示预填充之前。

template_name.en: DotTTS synthesis template. tts is normal text-to-speech; instruction_tts adds instruction conditioning; text_to_audio uses a sound-description template; tts_interleave uses the streaming interleave schedule; edit uses the DotTTS Edit source-audio editing schedule.
template_name.zh: DotTTS 合成模板。tts 为普通文本转语音；instruction_tts 增加指令条件；text_to_audio 使用声音描述模板；tts_interleave 使用流式交错调度；edit 使用 DotTTS Edit 的源音频编辑调度。

source_audio.en: Source WAV path for DotTTS Edit. Required when template_name=edit unless audio_input is supplied by the caller.
source_audio.zh: DotTTS Edit 的源 WAV 路径。template_name=edit 时必填，除非调用方提供了 audio_input。

instruction.en: Structured DotTTS Edit instruction. If omitted with template_name=edit, the request text is used as the instruction.
instruction.zh: 结构化的 DotTTS Edit 指令。template_name=edit 时可省略，此时以请求文本作为指令。

instruct.en: Alias for instruction for CLI compatibility.
instruct.zh: 为兼容 CLI 提供的 instruction 别名。

source_text.en: Optional source transcript override for DotTTS Edit. If omitted, it is rendered from instruction tags.
source_text.zh: DotTTS Edit 可选的源文本覆盖。省略时由指令标签生成。

target_text.en: Optional target transcript override for DotTTS Edit. If omitted, it is rendered from instruction tags.
target_text.zh: DotTTS Edit 可选的目标文本覆盖。省略时由指令标签生成。

use_xvector.en: DotTTS Edit speaker conditioning mode. auto follows the upstream tag-based behavior; on/off force or disable source-audio speaker conditioning.
use_xvector.zh: DotTTS Edit 的说话人条件模式。auto 遵循上游的按标签行为；on/off 强制启用或关闭源音频说话人条件。

language.en: Optional target language tag. none disables language tagging; otherwise pass a language code such as en or zh.
language.zh: 可选的目标语言标签。none 表示关闭语言标记；否则传入 en、zh 等语言代码。

num_inference_steps.en: SOAR flow-matching inference step count; default 10.
num_inference_steps.zh: SOAR 流匹配推理步数；默认 10。

guidance_scale.en: Classifier-free guidance scale used by SOAR flow matching. Default 1.2.
guidance_scale.zh: SOAR 流匹配使用的无分类器引导强度，默认 1.2。

speaker_scale.en: Multiplier applied to the prompt speaker embedding; default 1.5.
speaker_scale.zh: 作用于提示说话人嵌入的倍率；默认 1.5。

sampler_mode.en: SOAR ODE solver method for flow matching. Fixed-step euler is the default and parity baseline.
sampler_mode.zh: SOAR 流匹配的 ODE 求解方法。定步长 euler 为默认，也是对齐基线。

max_tokens.en: Maximum generated audio patch count per generated segment; default 500.
max_tokens.zh: 每个生成分段最多生成的音频 patch 数；默认 500。

seed.en: Seed for prompt latent sampling and flow noise initialization; default 42.
seed.zh: 提示隐变量采样与流噪声初始化的随机种子；默认 42。
